title: Ensuring Appropriate Use of NRIC Numbers across Public and Private Sector Transactions
what_it_is: Ensuring Appropriate Use of NRIC Numbers across Public and Private Sector Transactions

sections.label: NRIC numbers misuse plans
sections.summary: The Government explained plans to stop misuse of NRIC numbers as passwords for authentication and to move away from partial NRIC numbers for identification.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Jasmin Lau) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: In January 2025, the Government explained through a Ministerial Statement, its plans to improve the way National Registration Identity Card (NRIC) numbers are used.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Jasmin Lau) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: We are making progress in two main areas: stopping the misuse of NRIC numbers as passwords for authentication, in other words, to prove you are who you claim to be; and also, moving away from the use of partial NRIC numbers for identification.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Jasmin Lau) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: First, we are committed to stopping the use of NRIC numbers for authentication.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Jasmin Lau) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: Government agencies stopped this practice over a year ago and we are now working with private organisations to do the same.

sections.label: Penalties and partial NRIC numbers
sections.summary: Organisations flagrantly misusing NRIC numbers can be penalised under the Personal Data Protection Act, and the public sector is moving away from partial NRIC numbers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Jasmin Lau) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: While organisations will have adequate time to adjust their practices for compliance, those that flagrantly misuse NRIC numbers can be penalised under the Personal Data Protection Act.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Jasmin Lau) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: Second, we are moving away from the use of partial NRIC numbers, starting with the public sector.

sections.label: Full NRIC numbers and consultation
sections.summary: Agencies are starting to use full NRIC numbers where individuals must be identified accurately, and the Government will consult the public on private sector guidelines.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Jasmin Lau) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: Two, where individuals must be identified accurately, agencies are starting to use the full NRIC number instead, such as in official documents like licences and employment letters issued by the Government.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Jasmin Lau) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: For the private sector, the Government will consult the public before making any changes to guidelines for the use of partial NRIC numbers.
